identity_anchor: The unique asymmetrical organic blob shape containing a central play button cutout.
brand_cues_to_preserve: The specific irregular outer contour (resembling a stylized watermelon slice or fluid drop).
The central triangular play symbol (negative space).
The relative position of the play button within the organic mass.
semantic_cues_to_preserve: Video content implication via the play symbol.
structure_policy_rationale: Following the 'douyin' and 'alipay' reference patterns, the core logo geometry must be strictly preserved to maintain brand recognition. The transformation is purely material (flat red vector -> 3D ice sculpture) and dimensional (adding Z-axis thickness), without altering the silhouette or internal proportions.
design_rationale: Xigua Video's identity relies entirely on its unique organic silhouette. Following the theme's strict policy of 'identity via shape, not color', we must retain the exact outline but render it as a thick block of translucent ice. The original bright red is completely discarded in favor of the unified Ice Blue palette to fit the 'Frozen' theme environment.
must_preserve: The exact outer boundary curve of the red shape.
The triangular hole in the center.
Internal bubbles/snowflake textures within the ice volume.
can_recompose: Edge highlights (specular reflections to define the 3D form).
Base contact shadow and melting water puddle.
forbid: Flattening the icon into a 2D blue shape.
Changing the organic blob shape into a perfect circle or square.
generation_direction: 3D render of Xigua Video logo as a thick translucent ice sculpture. Pale cyan/ice-blue material with internal bubbles and snowflakes. Glossy wet surface with condensation. White background with soft shadow and water puddle at base. No red colors.
